terminal_record.title: CNN Reported Trump Used S&A Concrete for Trump Plaza
terminal_record.description_short: CNN reported Trump used S&A Concrete on Trump Plaza condominiums; a Second Circuit opinion described Salerno’s interest in S&A but reversed the appealing defendants’ convictions.
terminal_record.description_medium: CNN reported that Trump used S&A Concrete to build Trump Plaza condominiums and cited records identifying Anthony Salerno and Paul Castellano as controllers. In a related concrete-industry case, the Second Circuit recorded a jury forfeiture verdict involving Salerno’s interest in S&A, then reversed all appealing defendants’ convictions and remanded. The opinion does not mention Trump. This supports an attributed supplier relationship, not knowing participation or a RICO violation.
terminal_record.description_long: CNN reported that Trump used S&A Concrete to build Trump Plaza condominiums. CNN cited records identifying Anthony Salerno and Paul Castellano as controllers of S&A. A separate Second Circuit opinion in a federal concrete-industry case recorded a jury forfeiture verdict involving Salerno’s interest in S&A, then reversed all appealing defendants’ convictions and remanded. The opinion does not mention Trump. Taken together, the supplied text supports an attributed report of a supplier relationship and a court record about Salerno’s interest in the company. The supplied account does not establish that Trump knew of or joined a criminal scheme or violated RICO. The supplier report and the court proceedings remain distinct: CNN connects S&A with construction of the condominiums, while the opinion concerns a concrete-industry case and does not discuss Trump. The record should therefore describe the reported business relationship without converting it into proof of knowing collaboration or a criminal finding about Trump.
